subject_name: Aircraft Wiring Practices (Electrical wiring and Interface system)
topic: Components of rotor mast, control system, swash plate, torque link, drag damper, droop restrainer, clutch mechanism, rotor brake, feathering
syllabus_extract: Components of rotor mast, control system, swash plate, torque link, drag damper, droop restrainer, clutch mechanism, rotor brake, feathering sleeve etc.
specific_objectives: 12.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to explain various components of helicopter.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of rotor mast, swash plate, torque link, drag damper, droop restrainer, clutch, brake, and feathering sleeve on a cutaway model or diagram; Safety: Ensure no loose parts fall; Instructor supervision: Monitor identification accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the rotor mast?
How does the swash plate convert pilot input into blade pitch?
Why is a droop restrainer necessary in the rotor system?

topics: Swash plate tilt and pitch control
development.content:
Rotor mast structure and alignment
Control system linkage mechanics
Swash plate tilt and pitch control

topics: Torque link and drag damper function
Rotor brake and feathering sleeve operation
development.content:
Torque link and drag damper function
Droop restrainer and clutch mechanism
Rotor brake and feathering sleeve operation

Interconnection of rotor components
Failure modes of key components
Maintenance inspection points

summary_questions: Explain the role of the torque link in the control system.
Describe how the feathering sleeve adjusts blade pitch.
home_assignment_question: Draw a labeled diagram of the rotor mast and control system, indicating the path of control inputs from the swash plate to the rotor blades, referencing LP 02 concepts.

pft_rows.syllabus: Control horizontal and vertical movement, control of RPM, torque reaction, tail rotor compensations, contra rotating rotors.
